plugins.name: handoff-verifier
plugins.description: Self-verification hooks managed by in-session tools: a Stop reminder that forces one more reasoning turn before a turn ends, plus ExitPlanMode and AskUserQuestion gates that block the tool until you self-certify the constraints are met via a token confirm. Each check is set per global, project, or session scope, and the hook concatenates the active scopes broad-to-narrow

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Output styles and skills that control response prose: terse answers, ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, ADHD-shaped output, and removal of AI-sounding text

plugins.name: session-findings
plugins.description: Mine Claude Code session transcripts into self-contained per-session findings notes (bugs, development friction, reusable learnings) via a deterministic digest pass plus model classification; includes the digest/render scripts and a resumable sweep harness that writes findings.json and findings.md keyed by deterministic session id

plugins.name: bashkit-agents
plugins.description: Review pull requests in a sandbox using local .md files (`$STANDARDS_DIR`, default `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}/standards`)

plugins.name: jev
plugins.description: Review code, text and surface specs against my standards with jev: a reviewing edit agent, an audit agent, and a scan tool

plugins.name: surface-tools
plugins.description: Agent that justifies every node of a surface-spec capture, each request carrying only the current node's prompt and the justify tool's name and schema; logs every exchange through its proxy to JSONL when SURFACE_TOOLS_PROXY_LOG names a file

plugins.name: context-mangle
plugins.description: Agents whose requests are rewritten by the plugin's proxy: one answers a sequence of prompts with only the current prompt carried, and a mangle tool an agent calls to rewrite its own messages or system prompt with a regex
